name: Cheese Purrsuit
overview: Fast-paced cat catching mouse Typescript game
detailOverview:
Currently only available on Desktop. Mobile and Tablet versions coming out soon! 
In this fast-paced Typescript game, you transform into a cat trying to catch these cheese theieves running across the screen. Your goal is to catch as many mouse as the difficulty increase with the increase of level. With adjustable sound effects and an easy-to-access pause feature, the game keeps you in control and the action non-stop. Get ready to test your reflexes and expereicen the Cheese Purrsuit!
takeawayOpening: To enhance my scripting understanding, I decided to chanllenge myself to code an interactive game with a new language:
takeawayEnding: This project was challenging, but it was an amazing learning journey. There were many days when I was banging my head against the computer because I couldn't figure out why my game wasn't working the way I wanted, only to discover that different logic elements were contradicting each other. This project helped me understand how logic interacts within a system. It also allowed me to appreciate the advantages of using TypeScript for safe typing and error prevention.

name: WOWIES
overview: A React App for browsing the latest movies and building your own favourite lists.
detailOverview: Wowies, a movie database React app, showcases my skills in frontend development. With an intuitive interface, this app offers users an engaging browsing experience through a diverse collection of films. Throughout the development process, I focused on creating a user-friendly and responsive application that caters to movie enthusiasts of all levels. This project demonstrates my proficiency with React and highlights my ability to tackle real-world challenges and deliver polished, user-centric solutions.
featureExplain: A notable feature of the movie database app is the "Add to Favorites" feature. Users can create a personalized collection of favorite films by clicking a heart icon on the movie detail page. Once added, users can easily access and revisit their favorite movies anytime on their Favorites page. This feature provides a convenient way to keep track of favorite films.
designExplain:
The homepage focuses on making movie browsing simple and immediate, offering direct access to a wide range of movies and categories right from the start.
Another design choice of the movie database app is its  dark purple theme, which is easy on the eye and enhances the app's visual appeal and immersive experience.
takeawayOpening: From my experience working on the WOWIES movie database project, I've gained valuable insights into essential aspects of web development:
takeawayList: Storing and retrieving data from Local Storage
takeawayEnding: Such as fetching data from REST APIs, using React Router for smooth navigation, and storing and retrieving data from Local Storage. These takeaways have provided me with the skills needed to create dynamic and user-centric movie browsing experiences.

name: Portfolio Site
overview: My portfolio website, created with React and Tailwind CSS to showcase who I am and my skills
detailOverview: I created my portfolio using React and Tailwind CSS, showcasing modern web development techniques. Through React, I've developed a dynamic user interface that effectively displays my projects. Tailwind CSS ensures a responsive design across various devices, providing a smooth browsing experience. With a JSON file managing the portfolio's data, updating project details is effortless, eliminating the need for manual coding. This approach streamlines content management and lays the foundation for scalability and adaptability. These technologies collectively demonstrate my proficiency in crafting robust and user-centric web applications.
featureExplain: One of the portfolio feature is its dynamic handling of data. This means that the portfolio can easily update and display new information or content without manual intervention. For instance, I can add, remove, or update projects or achievements by editing my json file, without needing to modify the website's code. This dynamic capability ensures that my portfolio stays current and reflects my latest accomplishments.
designExplain: I created this website with a mobile-first design approach. This approach ensures that the portfolio is user-friendly and accessible on mobile devices, prioritizing visitors browsing on smartphones and tablets first. By placing importance on mobile compatibility, their portfolio provides a seamless experience across different screen sizes, emphasizing accessibility for all users.
takeawayOpening: While working on my portfolio website, I've learned valuable skills and improved my ability to troubleshoot issues, gaining insights into important aspects of dynamic web development:
takeawayList: Storing and retrieving data from Local Storage
takeawayEnding:
I've gained new experience in skills such as data fetching and proficiently storing and retrieving data from local storage (JSON files), and using Tailwind CSS for efficient styling. 
These abilities enable me to develop dynamic and responsive web applications with streamlined data management, enhancing user experience and functionality. As I continue to refine and expand upon these skills, I am ready to tackle new challenges and deliver impactful web solutions.

name: Froth Matcha Cafe
overview: WordPress website, featuring a curated selection of matcha drinks and pastries
detailOverview: Our WordPress website, tailored for a mock local matcha cafe, focuses on the design and development process when working with a client. To mimic client collaboration, we emphasized meeting deadlines and crafted a user-friendly interface that highlights essential details such as location, hours, and menu offerings. Additionally, we integrated social media feeds so customers can stay informed about the latest news and promotions. This project showcases our expertise in website design and development, emphasizing our dedication to meeting client needs and delivering quality work within specified timelines.
takeawayOpening: While working in a team of four, the Froth Matcha Cafe allowed us to pratcied the following skills:
takeawayList: Customizing a WordPress theme and appropriate selection of plugins
Planning content plan, information architeture and wireframing
Agile tools and methodologies for project management
takeawayEnding: This project allowed us to understand the importance of planning content, information architecture, and wireframing when working with clients to enforce consistency throughout the development process. We used Asana as our preferred communication tool to implement agile methodology during development for project management.

name: Taipei Website
overview: A website showcases Taipei's culinary delights and stunning scenery
detailOverview: My first website, the Taipei Country website, marked an exciting milestone in my journey as a web developer. This project was the result of my passion for coding and my desire to showcase the beauty and culture of Taipei to the world. Every step of the process was filled with learning opportunities and challenges. As the website went live, I felt a sense of pride and accomplishment, knowing that my creation was now accessible to a global audience, serving as a gateway to Taipei's sights, foods, and experiences.
takeawayOpening: As my first website I developed, these are some basic skills that learnt:
takeawayEnding: Developing the Taipei Country website was a significant learning experience for me, improving both my technical skills and project management abilities. Through this project, I gained valuable insights into problem-solving and troubleshooting, which have made me a more resilient and adaptable developer.
